result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousels, category chips and bottom-cut card are intentional scroll behavior and were not reported. One clear content defect is the '-100%' discount badge on the pizza card, which implies the item is free and is likely a data or formatting error. A few minor styling and contrast concerns also exist.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge. That would mean the item is completely free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting bug, and it is inconsistent with the other cards' '€0 delivery' style badges.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data and display the correct discount (e.g. '-10%'). Also make sure the badge format is consistent with the other badges.

issues.description: Secondary gray text, such as the delivery fee lines and the '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' metadata, has low contrast against the white background. The search placeholder is also light gray on light gray.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and placeholder colors to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left edge of the carousel images and are offset from the card edge. On the first card the pill sits over the plate image, which looks slightly cramped. The heart icon on the pizza card is also a dark translucent circle on a busy background, so it is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Align the pills with consistent padding inside the image. Give the favorite button a more opaque background for clearer visibility.
